description: Recorded test measurements (plan leaf F-09.1, as amended on 2026-11-11: test runtime is diagnostic, not a gate). Counts and wall medians of the reference profile, per category, per suite and in total; wall_s is a median over wall.runs serial runs on the reference host. They are compared as notes only, never as gates, and need no update when tests are added. A median above wall_s x (1 + signals.regression), and never below wall_s + wall.min_slack_s, or a serial total above signals.full_suite_s, is an investigation signal. What blocks is the recorded test set (recorded_tests): removed or newly skipped tests. Checked by tools/check_test_budget.py (task test:budget), never in a hook.
